skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK, 100% chance to inflict [Internal Injury] (deals 100% of Bomb's ATK when the target is attacked, then disappears after triggering).

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks enemies in a row with 6 consecutive strikes, dealing 510% ATK. 100% chance to inflict [Internal Injury] on the main target (deals 500% of Bomb's ATK when attacked, then disappears after triggering).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, gains 60% chance of [Evade] (reduces Direct/Extra/Charge/Berserk DMG to 1 DMG), lasting 5 rounds.After any character acts, absorbs 40% of [Internal Injury] DMG on enemies and deals [Specialized Extra DMG] (can Crit, not affected by [Specialized DMG Reflect]) to all enemies.For the first 5 rounds, before any character acts, recovers 500% ATK of HP, 3 times per round.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: [Evade] chance 60% → 70%[Internal Injury] DMG absorbed 40% → 50%HP recovery 3 times per round → 4 times per round

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: [Evade] duration 5 rounds → 8 rounds[Internal Injury] DMG absorbed 50% → 60%HP recovery 500% → 650%

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: When Bomb attacks, summons Silverfang to deal [Combo Attack] with the same attack style. Basic - Deals 100% Bomb's ATK damage to a random target. Ultimate - Attacks all enemies with 5 consecutive strikes and deals damage by 150% Bomb's ATK and have 75% chance of inflicting [Internal Injury] on main target (deals 450% of Bomb's ATK when attacked and disappears after triggered)

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Silverfang ult dmg 150% > 200% Internal Injury chance 75% > 90% Internal Injury dmg 450% > 600%

effects.desc: Damage over time based on ST, disappears after activation; Can Detonate to explode.
